name: F1 Durban
summary: **F1 Durban** is a [[kind:cut|cut]] line of [[durban-poison|Durban Poison]] first grown out by a cultivator known as Chang, reportedly around 1998. It later became a parent used in [[gsc|Girl Scout Cookies]] breeding, sometimes cited as its Durban Poison-derived parent. Its own origin and breeder affiliation remain undocumented beyond that early account.

sources.title: F1 Durban (Unknown or Legendary)
sources.note: Lists F1 Durban's parentage as an F1 hybrid x Durban Poison and notes its role as an ancestor of later hybrid strains.

sources.title: F1 Durban by Unknown or Legendary: A Comprehensive Strain Guide
sources.note: Sole source found for the 1998/Chang origin account; treat the specific date with caution as it is not corroborated elsewhere.
